Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: In the second step (its second turn), the Planner incorrectly asserted that the "larger Hall of Fame" recognizing the IBF is the "World Boxing Hall of Fame (WBHF)." This is factually incorrect; the primary and most recognized larger Hall of Fame for boxing organizations and inductees is the International Boxing Hall of Fame (IBHOF) located in Canastota, New York. The World Boxing Hall of Fame is not the standard entity referenced in this context. Additionally, the Planner jumped to a conclusion (`TASK_COMPLETE`) without verifying the correct Hall of Fame through the WebSurfer, relying on a hallucinated fact instead of the information gathered from the search results.
